answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Reddit karma in three unrelated subreddits changes that arithmetic: karma earned in places that share nothing, so the zenith for each fake is paid in the real world. Honest agents barely notice the check, because karma earned in places that share nothing is something they already have; the raven falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the prism of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
